title: Public scalar acceptance evidence for portable checkpoint training/export/native deployment

repository.head: d51b578fdf4a6b4b516ed1987bc87aeff8830306
repository.shared_worktree_note: Evidence was produced in a shared worktree with pre-existing unrelated modifications. Audit statuses are recorded separately from child-case gates.

scope.summary: Bounded acceptance for eight checkpoint arms: four original native deployments and four training/export/deploy cases at explicit diagnostic LR=1e-5, plus one no-update native control and one preserved LR=1e-3 failure. Two further stateless RGB smoke cases exercise the accepted FP32-trained FP16 exports through learned preprocess, RGB trunk and postprocess.
scope.native_checks: The original-native and training/export native comparisons cover the reconstructed network trunk (Legacy71 b69 and Small31 native schedules). Full stateless RGB smoke coverage is recorded separately in full_rgb. None establishes vendor DLL equivalence.
scope.training_checks: Training checks cover train/export/deploy integration only. They are not quality training evidence and are not a generally validated learning-rate recipe.
scope.learning_rate: 1e-5 is an explicit diagnostic step size for this bounded run, not a correctness fix for the preserved 1e-3 failure and not a validated recipe.
